messages:
maya: quick design check — putting this here from today's huddle. compact 'error path' (request drilldown) mockups attached in Figma. main things we flagged: collapsed correlation-id visibility, export/save wording, and screen-reader announcements on save/export. thoughts?

igor: can we keep a small pill visible when collapsed? like `corr-id: 1234...` truncated with a hover to reveal and a copy icon. keyboard focus should land on the pill before actions.

sam: +1 on pill. question: when collapsed, do we show the 1-line error summary above the pill or below? product prefers above so users see context first.

maya: prefer above too. puts context first. design-wise we should reserve right-side for actions (copy, download, open full trace).

sara: a11y note — if we add a copy button we need an aria-live update for SRs. suggested live text: 'Correlation ID copied to clipboard' (polite). also keyboard only users should get a visible focus ring on the pill and action menu.

lin: on export wording — we currently have `Download trace` across the app. some partners asked for `Save snapshot` because they think it's clearer for a static export. i'm leaning `Save snapshot` for drilldowns and keep `Download trace` on full trace page.

igor: prefer `Save snapshot` for drilldown + small tooltip: 'includes request headers + stacktrace'. shorter main label keeps the action tidy in compact mode.

maya: copy proposals for the save flow:
- button label: `Save snapshot`
- success toast (visual): `Snapshot saved — open in Trace Viewer` (links to viewer)
- screen reader: use aria-live polite: `Snapshot saved. Press Enter to open trace.`

sara: minor tweak — SRs shouldn't be told to 'Press Enter' unless it's the only actionable focus. suggest: `Snapshot saved. Link to open trace available.` keeps it neutral.

lin: agree. also let's add role=alert for failures: `Snapshot failed to save` + focus trap to the toaster so SR users notice.

design-bot: uploaded Figma comps -> https://www.figma.com/file/XXXXX/compact-error-path

maya: i'll update the mock with the pill, move actions to right, swap label to `Save snapshot`, and change SR copy to Sara's suggestion. pinging @igor @sam for a quick sign-off before I push to PR.

igor: sign-off from me if the pill is tabbable and has aria-label="Correlation ID: 1234... (copy)".

sam: sign-off. small ask — can the pill show a subtle ⚠️ when the downstream service latency is >500ms? useful to triage quickly.

maya: noted. will add a state for that.

sara: i'll draft the accessibility acceptance checks (focus order, live region text, keyboard copy) and add to the PR checklist.

maya: thanks all — i'll post the updated comps and attach the copy snippets in the PR description once ready. :thumbsup:
